about: The falsifier: an act held the places its lines named, and a change to the instrument's code moves every place's key. B35 at epoch 253 changed bound's fold and held bound/ and the root, so every other place was left unsettled; lane A's lot at epoch 255, five lines at topos, then spent 57.7 s of its 90 s in gate/check folding places it did not touch, and could not settle them: OUTSIDE for topos-node, topos-notation, topos-typescript-tree and verify.
